sentences.text: This loggerhead was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Young loggerheads spend years in the open ocean before settling closer to shore.
Its last position was its farthest, {max_displacement_km} from where its track began: {species_rank_distance}.
Its whole track stays between {southernmost_lat} and {northernmost_lat}.
